newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bangladesh's Water Development Board said the water level at different points of the river Padma rose on Wednesday as the Ganges water sharing treaty between Dhaka and Delhi took effect.

A regional conference of boards of investment of countries in the Asia Pacific region will be held in Dhaka in April this year to explore scopes for Foreign Direct Investment and relocation of industries.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationlist Party (BNP) has vowed to resist any move by the government to allow India trade transit.
Jatiya Party has urged the government to form an inquiry commission to review the cases against its leader deposed President Hussain Mohammad Ershad.
More than 20,000 Bangladeshis who fled Iraq and Kuwait during the Gulf war in 1990 will get a package of compensation worth about $50 million, government officials said.
Main opposition BNP on Wednesday hinted at an intensified anti-governemnt street agitation after the holy month of Ramadan.
The government will ask for offers from four power genertion companies to set up a 300 megawatt power generation plant in eastern Sylhet district.
ANZ Grindlays Bank has launched taka credit cards for the first time in Bangladesh.
